test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select ‘No substitution required’.

Anurag said that he __is being fined__ by a policeman for not wearing a mask last evening.
solution:
The correct answer is **'had been fined'. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part has an error in the tense used. 
 
• The underlined part states *is being fined *which is in the **present tense format. **
 
• But the incident occurred in the past (last evening) and ended there itself. it was not a continuous event. 
 
• Thus, we need to use the **past perfect continuous tense** for the underlined part. 
 
• Hence, the underlined part should be replaced with **had been fined ** which is the past perfect continuous tense form. 
 
• So, **option 2 **is the correct answer. 

***Correct sentence - ****Anurag said that he **had been fined__**** **by a policeman for not wearing a mask last evening.*
